programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2

programme.title: Hajime No Ippo: The Fighting!
programme.desc: Ippo starts the third round by charging at Sendo but then hesitates, which leads to Sendo beating Ippo all through the third round; the fourth round is a different story, being more in the favor of Ippo.

programme.title: Hajime No Ippo: The Fighting!
programme.desc: A flashback shows how Sendo joined his gym; Ippo gets knocked down two times but when he gets up the fifth round gets more brutal; the fifth round ends and after that, the sixth round begins and is just as brutal as the last round.

programme.title: Future Boy Conan
programme.desc: Conan and Jimsy attempt to stowaway aboard the Barracuda, but are caught and punished by the ship's captain Dyce; they get to work as the ship heads for Industria.

programme.title: Future Boy Conan
programme.desc: The Barracuda finally arrives in Industria and Conan and Jimsy are stunned to find it bleak and deserted; Conan races through the complex searching for Lana.

programme.title: Future Boy Conan
programme.desc: Conan and Lana are finally reunited but the villainous Lepka continues to pursue them; shocked by Lepka's brutality, Captain Dyce's allegiances begin to shift.

programme.title: Cromartie High School
programme.desc: Takenouchi faces a hard choice: get on an airplane with his motion sickness, or allow hijackers to commit a serious crime.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and friends receive an invitation to board the luxury liner Sirloin, not realizing the reunion is actually a trap plotted by Mister X.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: Wads of Bills Blossomed in the Sunset of Rio
programme.desc: An international soccer game is taking place in Rio de Janeiro and Lupin has his eyes on a box office heist.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: An old man who supposedly knows the secret to Hitler's legacy lives in East Germany within the Berlin Wall; Lupin and his gang track the old man down, but the old man can't recall anything.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The Loch Ness Monster reveals itself from the lake, charmed by Fujiko's singing; seeking personal gain, Doctor Oz decides to use Fujiko to capture Nessie.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: I'll Teach You How to Transport Gold Bars
programme.desc: Fujiko and a mystery man have an enticing job for Lupin: stealing gold bullion from a Swiss bank renowned for its tight security.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: Is the Leaning Tower of Pisa Standing?
programme.desc: A man threatens to destroy the Leaning Tower of Pisa with a device that generates artificial earthquakes; the Italian government has no choice but to meet the culprit's demands.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin is possessed by an ominous curse after a heist involving the golden death mask of Tutankhamen.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The Trans-Europe Superexpress train departs Venice for France; onboard is crime boss Don Marcino and his illegally acquired treasures.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: Would You Like Ukiyo-e Blues? (Now Museum, Now You Don't)
programme.desc: Lupin meets the grandson of master Ukiyoe artist, Toushusai Sharaku and learns that he has been switching his own works with his grandfather's originals; unable to switch the latest painting, he asks Lupin to switch it instead.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and Fujiko are invited to a party hosted by Marcel Dulane, a member of Paris' high society; the elegant party turns out to be a trap.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: Bet on the Monaco Grand Prix!
programme.desc: Lupin travels to Monaco to race in the Monaco Grand Prix but runs into some trouble at the casino.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: A rare bottle of Bordeaux, commissioned by Napoleon for his beloved wife, is to be given to the President of the United States as a Christmas present; Lupin and his gang decide to steal the wine while it's in transport over the Atlantic.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Great Chase in San Francisco
programme.desc: A criminal gang hides a microfilm containing the manufacturing process for artificial diamonds, developed by NASA, in one of Inspector Zenigata's molars.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Forward Hees, the world's richest man, suddenly dies a mysterious death and leaves a large ruby to Fujiko in his will; after inheriting the ruby, Fujiko comes down with the same fever as Hees.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Case of The Risible Dirigible
programme.desc: A Count challenges Lupin to steal a gemstone named Dracula's Tear which is on board his airship, the Hendenburg.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin suffers from transformation sickness, an illness that transforms him into a cruel, cold-blooded criminal at the stroke of midnight.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: An Arab nation receives a blackmail notice; they must pay a $100 million or have their oil fields blown up.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: After capturing the world's largest emerald, Lupin hides it in a museum to retrieve at a later time.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The Marukin Safe Company is forced into bankruptcy after Lupin cracks open their impenetrable safe; to test his own skills, Marukin's son challenges Lupin to open a safe that he has designed.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: While trying to steal General Hatler's prize medallion, Lupin inadvertently reels in Hatler's biggest secret, his toupee; an enraged General Hatler orders Lupin and his gang to be killed.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Upon returning to Japan, Goemon finds his master on the brink of death; Jinkuro, a fellow disciple, steals half of the scroll containing the secret arts of the Iga Ninja.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin and Jigen are invited to a remote manor full of beautiful women who plan to expose them to aging gas.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: A mysterious woman who claims to be Fujiko's aunt gives Lupin an ultimatum; he must find Marshal Rommel's lost gold or die.

programme.title: Lupin the Third Part 2
programme.desc: The great thief Nezumi-Kozou Jirokichi IV appears before Goemon and reveals that their ancestors competed in the first International Thieves Championship together, but were defeated by Lupin's grandfather, Arsène Lupin.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Encounter With the Deadly Iron Lizard
programme.desc: The warden of an African prison holds Fujiko captive; Lupin and his gang infiltrate the prison and attempt to break Fujiko out, but they become the target of the Iron Lizards.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Linda, a beautiful dancer, has stolen Jigen's heart and a vengeful Meyer has taken Fujiko hostage; unaware that Linda and Meyer are working together, Lupin and Jigen are set up to kill each other.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess; Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl named Alice who also wants the stamp tags along.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris; Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: The Wind in Morocco Is Hot
programme.desc: Lupin and his arch-nemesis Inspector Zenigata are kidnapped and are forcibly conscripted into the French Foreign Legion in Morocco; they end up shackled together and have to work together to make a run for it.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: In Stockholm, twins Latica and Anita constantly fight over who gets to claim the hidden Viking treasure that their father discovered; they each have half of a map that leads to the Viking treasure tattooed on their backs.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: A hit has been ordered on Lupin, and Puma, a formidable hit man, who specializes in long-range attacks, is on his trail; Lupin takes his chances with a one-on-one showdown at close range against Puma.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.desc: Orion's Crown has been stolen and is up for grabs at a black-market auction; Lupin has his eyes on the crown and the auction money, but he must outsmart the other parties vying for the crown first.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Lupin Who Turned Into a Vampire

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd Part 2
programme.sub-title: Uncover the Secret of Tsukikage Castke

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Buhay Kamao
programme.desc: Pepe, did not want anything to do with boxing but the easy money involved in the sport attracted him when he was desperate to pay off a long standing debt. Little did he know that the match was just the beginning of a series of tests.

programme.title: Gandarrapiddo: The Revenger Squad
programme.desc: The Revenger Squad reveal their superpowers when one of their youngest turns twenty-one and receives his own powers.

programme.title: Won't Last A Day Without You
programme.desc: DJ Heidee (Sarah Geronimo) provides love advice to people who are having problems in their relationships. In the process of getting Melissa and Andrew together, Heidee begin to feel an attraction toward Andrew.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Mahal
programme.desc: Lira (Kylie Verzosa), a prize-winning author, spends a week to finish her final novel. But when she meets Andrei (Zanjoe Marudo), a young documentarist, her plans start to change.

programme.title: Kaluskos
programme.desc: Amid the custody battle, Rebekah (Coleen Garcia) finds another \"Amaya\" under the bed. Wanting to start a new life with the other Amaya, Rebekah seeks to set her free. But to do that, she needs to kill the impostor.

programme.title: Tragic Theater
programme.desc: A team of exorcists are sent into an old theater that is rumored to have been the site of a great tragedy during its construction.

programme.title: Sa Haba ng Gabi
programme.desc: When a zombie outbreak happens, two housemaids and a driver will need to survive their longest night ever as they get trapped inside the mansion.

programme.title: Ang Manananggal sa Unit 23B
programme.desc: Jewel is a mysterious woman who lives alone in the city. She has a secret which has led her to settle into a lonely existence. That is, until she meets Nico, a broken-hearted, down-and-out guy who also feels unlovable like she does.

programme.title: Sino? Alin Sa Dalawa?
programme.desc: When Magda's grandmother dies, the opportunity for her and her mother, Aling Meding to be reunited comes. Unfortunately, their relationship soon turns sour when her stepfather attempts to rape her.

programme.title: When The Love Is Gone
programme.desc: The movie is a remake of the 1983 blockbuster movie directed by Danny Zialcita entitled Nagalit ang Buwan sa Haba ng Gabi. A gripping, moving story of love lost, love gained, love betrayed, and love unbound.

programme.title: Banyo Queen
programme.desc: Angelie (Rica Peralejo) comes from a family of sorceress. As a tradition, everyone should have a virgin sacrifice before their 18th birthday to escape the curse. With the help of her Aunt Chada (Mystica), she hunts a virgin to stay alive.

programme.title: Pangako... Ikaw Lang
programme.desc: Vince (Aga Muhlach) is comatose and mistakes Cristina (Regine Velasquez) as his guardian angel when he sees her as he opened his eyes. He finds her to get to know her better.

programme.title: Magnum Muslim .357
programme.desc: A Muslim undercover cop, Lieutenant Jamal Razul a.k.a Magnum (ER Ejercito) tracks down a criminal syndicate behind the kidnapping of the Muslim Princess Ameerah (Sam Pinto). Aided by fellow officer Joselito Ibanez (Jerico Ejercito), Razul discovers that there’s more to the kidnapping than mere ransom.

programme.title: Elevator
programme.desc: Trapped inside the elevator of a hotel casino complex, an elevator boy falls in love with his investor's girlfriend that forces him to choose between his love for her, or his dreams for a better future.

programme.title: Lastikman: Unang Banat
programme.desc: Disguised in his sharp green and black get-up he is Lastikman, a hip, young dude whose kind heart brings help to the oppressed, the defenseless or to anybody in danger.

programme.title: Praybeyt Benjamin
programme.desc: Vice plays the role of Benjamin Santos whose family has a long tradition of serving in the military. Conflict ensues when Lolo Benjamin (Eddie Garcia) found out that his grandson is gay.

programme.title: Kamandag ng Droga
programme.desc: An all-too-real film on the country's current war on drugs, the film tackles the angle of the family members and community of addicts and pushers.

programme.title: Upline Downline
programme.desc: A young man struggling to support his family enters the world of multilevel marketing.

programme.title: Swipe
programme.desc: When CCTV cameras are installed in Sunrise Apartment, the tenants’ lives begin to unravel through their discreet activities in social media dating sites.

programme.title: Nanay, Tatay
programme.desc: Three orphans escape captivity, get adopted by grieving parents who lost their demonically possessed daughter. The possessed daughter hunts the orphans, forcing them to commit crimes. Multiple deaths occur, including the parents.

programme.title: Waves
programme.desc: Waves is a romantic drama about the intimate relationship between Ross \u0026 Sofia - two old friends passionately in love yet life's cultural, geographical, and emotional obstacles get in the way.

programme.title: Kulimlim
programme.desc: The past has come to haunt Jake Cabrera. Based on technicality, the Supreme Court has ordered the release of the three men convicted of raping his wife after eight years in prison. Jake decides to render his own brand of justice and seeks the help of a retired colonel. This is Robin Padilla's finest dramatic performance yet.

programme.title: Patient X
programme.desc: After twenty years, local police captures the murderer of the older brother of a young boy. Now a doctor, he must go back to his old town and face the murderers himself. He then discovers that the murderers are Aswangs.

programme.title: Sugo ng Tondo
programme.desc: Tondo was shocked to learn that their hero is dead. Rigor, (Joko Diaz) an upright policeman who has been instrumental in clearing Tondo. But Rigor shows up again as \"Sugo ng Tondo\" because he continues to fight crime the way he used to.

programme.title: Ang Huling Henya
programme.desc: Miri is trapped in her past and this time her whole past comes crashing back into her life: old dead secrets, her dead parents, and even the walking dead. Miris return to Manila only brings her back to more trouble the personal kind.

programme.title: Reyna
programme.desc: Ginnieffer Balisteros, a sad,insecure and desperate woman who feels the need to win a beauty pageant to prove her self-worth.

programme.title: Hindi Tayo Pwede
programme.desc: Gabby (Lovi Poe) finds love in a man who is also named Gabby (Tony Labrusca) and shares a long and deep friendship with Dennis (Marco Gumabao).

programme.title: Of All The Things
programme.desc: Already falling for each other, Berns starts maneuvering things to help Umboy retake the bar exams as he battles his fears to reclaim his self-esteem.

programme.title: Pakboys Takusa
programme.desc: Four playboy husbands sneak out to be with other women. But when one of them dates a girlfriend of a mafia boss, their lives are put at stake.

programme.title: Walang Kapalit
programme.desc: A marriage gone sour with the husband leaving the wife, taking along a minor daughter and lying to her about her mother. Meanwhile, each carries a relationship with other parties. Deciding to forego their annulment case, they commit to give their marriage a second try.
